name: Hirose Yuuki
source:
Tsukiyado High 1st Year, Class 3.
Member of the broadcasting club and HR committee.

He is friendly and has good leadership skills, and is a versatile type who can do anything.
He is calm and mature for his age, and his personality is the safest compared to the people around him.
However, he is merciless and speaks harshly to the broadcasting department advisor (Yonehara), who sometimes goes out of control.
Good at calculating profit and loss.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/kaerubatake/char_hirose.html]official website[/url].]
